assumptions.statement: An account executive hired in Q1 2026 delivers the equivalent of 6 fully productive months in 2026 (average start mid-February, linear ramp to full productivity over 9 months: 1.5 full months + 9 ramp months at 50%)
assumptions.rationale: The CS notes give 9 months to full productivity (F0065) but no ramp curve or start dates; a linear ramp from a mid-Q1 start is the neutral reading and is generous versus a back-loaded hiring plan
assumptions.validate: Actual start dates and month-by-month new ARR of the 2025 AE hires, before the wave-1 offer letters

assumptions.statement: The first-year cohort entering 2026 carries about the same ARR at risk as the 2025 first-year cohort (€18.2M), so restoring the 2024 first-year churn rate of 12% saves about the same €2.5M
assumptions.rationale: New ARR was flat (9.4 to €9.6M), so the cohort size should be similar; the effect is an upper bound because onboarding restored in Q1 helps the 2025 cohort only partly
assumptions.validate: Time to first value and 90-day churn of the Q1-Q2 2026 cohort, reviewed at the June board

assumptions.statement: First hiring wave sized at 10 account executives (one third of the CRO request), a decision parameter rather than a data point
assumptions.rationale: Keeps new-logo capacity growing while the onboarding team is rebuilt; no source shows that sales capacity bound 2025 growth (H4 unresolved), so the remaining 20 are held behind gate G1
assumptions.validate: Gate G1 at the June 2026 board decides wave 2
